summary: Security review of exact commit 4e41eff8f4ef47f395df3866e88305e9f2564375 requires one further change. The five prior blocking findings are remediated: exact bounded nested shapes reject the original content/type and complexity bypasses; strict parsing rejects NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, and parser recursion; CARIN status/findings are derived issue-by-issue only after verifying raw evidence plus the validator, runtime, and all 30 package archives; the required DATA001_REQUIRE_OFFLINE lifecycle check passed; and outcomes separate declared from observed source-byte digests. The ADR link is corrected, the 75 required-offline data tests and 12 agentic tests pass, verification commit c1ca263efa79f2ad235ac4df656f51a8deb0dd18 is current because later changes are only verification evidence and task status, and synthetic-only, CARIN-advisory, terminology-unverified, reference non-dereference, no-production/upload, evidence-grounding, and human-authority invariants remain intact. A combined malicious source path and early classification/role failure can still escape sanitization, and arbitrary normalized repository paths can reach accepted with schema-invalid evidence.

findings.description: Source paths are not validated and canonicalized before classification and role-set failures use source_set.documents[0].path in a finding. A prohibited-real-phi source with path dataset/../../EVIL followed by a newline-controlled marker is rejected but echoes that untrusted path and fails validation-outcome.schema.json. Separately, the path gate checks only normalized relative syntax, not the outcome contract's dataset/ or tests/fixtures/fhir/data-001/ roots; a project-authored source set whose four paths are under other/ receives decision=accepted and then produces hundreds of schema-invalid terminology evidence paths. The schema sourcePath pattern itself also permits traversal segments when no control character is present.
findings.impact: Invalid or prohibited input can break the promised structured fail-safe outcome and inject misleading/control text into logs or downstream evidence. The missing source-root allowlist also weakens file-origin and synthetic-fixture provenance boundaries by allowing accepted evidence to reference arbitrary repository locations.
findings.remediation: Validate path length, allowed root, normalization, traversal, uniqueness, and classification/role-specific path policy before any failure can include a source path. Use a fixed safe placeholder or digest when the supplied path is invalid, strengthen the outcome schema to exclude traversal/dot/control/backslash forms, and add combined prohibited-class plus malicious-path, invalid-role plus malicious-path, and arbitrary-normalized-root tests that always return a schema-valid sanitized rejected outcome.
